talking_points: Nvidia reports its first earnings since Jensen Huang's shock resignation, with investors watching for clues on China exposure and neocloud financing risk.
California has become the first state to sue OpenAI over 'rogue agent' incidents, arguing the company shipped an unsafe product without proper safeguards.
AMD has closed its $8.2 billion purchase of World Labs, putting AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li in charge of its push into 'spatial intelligence'.
